preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 5000.
The number of roads m must be between 0 and 5000.
The index of the capital s must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of new roads needed to make all cities reachable from the capital.
